scripts.build: astro build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['sitemap.xml', 'sitemap_index.xml', 'sitemap-index.xml', '_redirects', '_headers', 'robots.txt', '404.html'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync('dist/' + f)) { fs.copyFileSync('dist/' + f, f); fs.copyFileSync('dist/' + f, 'public/' + f); } });"
